icrNoDirection2024.documentTitle: The contribution of the Financial Policy Committee to UK financial stability

modelMapping.ltiWindow: The 2024 FPC Record confirms the active LTI flow-limit policy; PRA PS5/17 confirms four-quarter rolling compliance. The monthly Java model maps four quarters to 12 monthly model steps.
modelMapping.icrFloor: The FPC has powers of Direction over DTI/ICR limits but had not used those powers for owner-occupier or buy-to-let mortgages as of the 25 September 2024 Bank of England article. CENTRAL_BANK_ICR_HARD_MIN is therefore set to 0.0 to represent no separate central-bank hard ICR floor.
modelMapping.effectiveIcrConstraint: Bank.java uses max(BANK_ICR_HARD_MIN, CENTRAL_BANK_ICR_HARD_MIN), so the effective BTL ICR floor remains max(1.25, 0.0) = 1.25.

methodDecision: Objective=direct method justification; Why=the residual central-bank policy keys should distinguish active FPC policy from lender-side underwriting constraints; Tradeoff=CENTRAL_BANK_LTI_MONTHS_TO_CHECK uses a 2017 implementation source to map the active 2024 LTI policy to monthly steps, while CENTRAL_BANK_ICR_HARD_MIN=0.0 is a non-binding model sentinel rather than an observed numeric ICR threshold.
